name: Scottish Aviation Bulldog
summary: Scottish side-by-side aerobatic trainer derived from the Beagle Pup, used by the RAF and many air forces and now popular as a private sport and display airplane.

wings: Low, tapered cantilever wing with squared tips
engines: Single four-cylinder Lycoming with a two-blade propeller
fuselage: Large one-piece sliding bubble canopy over side-by-side seats
tail: Tall, sharply swept fin and rudder
Horizontal stabilizer mounted on the rear fuselage

tellTales: Huge bubble canopy over side-by-side seats on a stubby low-wing airplane
Tall swept fin and fixed tricycle gear with a short nose

confusedWith.howToTell: The Chipmunk has tandem seats and a tailwheel; the Bulldog has side-by-side seats and a nose wheel.
The P-Mentor has a modern composite look and wheel pants; the Bulldog has a much bigger, more bubble-like canopy and a tall, sharply swept fin.
The SF.260 has retractable gear and tip tanks; the Bulldog has fixed gear and no tip tanks.
The DA20 is a rounder composite; the Bulldog is an angular metal airplane with a tall swept fin.
